notSuites.tests/run-suites.mjs: The runner itself. Discovers and spawns every other suite.
notSuites.tests/worker-integration.mjs: Integration driver, not a suite. Boots `wrangler dev` and spawns the live-worker suites against it. Owned by `npm run test:integration:worker`.
notSuites.tests/pinned-schema-version.mjs: Shared helper module with no assertions. Exports PINNED_SCHEMA_VERSION, read out of src/sync/schema.ts, for the plain-node suites that cannot import the TypeScript constant.

skip.tests/server-update-local.mjs: Owned by `npm run test:server-update-local`, which runs `build:server-release` first. Needs dist/release-assets/yaos-server.zip on disk and shells out to git in a temp clone.
skip.tests/schema-guard.mjs: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/worker-integration.mjs; needs a running server on 127.0.0.1:8787 and SYNC_TOKEN.
skip.tests/provider-manual-connect.mjs: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/worker-integration.mjs; exits non-zero without SYNC_TOKEN.
skip.tests/sync-client.ts: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/worker-integration.mjs with positional args (file path, text); needs a running server and SYNC_TOKEN.
skip.tests/snapshots.ts: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/worker-integration.mjs; needs a running server, SYNC_TOKEN, and an R2 binding for snapshot routes.
skip.tests/hardening-worker.mjs: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/worker-integration.mjs; needs a running server and SYNC_TOKEN.
skip.tests/ws-ticket-reconnect.mjs: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/worker-integration.mjs, which starts the server with YAOS_TICKET_TTL_MS:8000 so post-expiry reconnect is reachable in seconds.
skip.tests/ws-admission-protocol.mjs: Live-worker suite. Spawned by tests/worker-integration.mjs; needs a running server and SYNC_TOKEN.
skip.tests/live-seed-check.mjs: Manual probe against a deployed server. Throws unless YAOS_TEST_HOST, SYNC_TOKEN, and YAOS_TEST_VAULT_ID are all set.
skip.tests/persistence-handoff-proof.mjs: Issue #24 RCA experiment against a live server. Throws without SYNC_TOKEN; two-device handoff over real WebSockets.
skip.tests/persistence-eviction-proof.mjs: Issue #24 RCA experiment. Defaults YAOS_TEST_HOST to a real deployment URL and sleeps 160s waiting for Durable Object eviction — far too slow and too external for the regression gate.

serialReason: These suites write into the repo tree, so they must never run concurrently with each other or with a build. The runner is sequential today, which satisfies this for free; the list exists so that adding parallelism cannot silently break it.
